# Atlas Canvas

Atlas is a persistent visual knowledge workspace shared by people and agents.

Agent discovery: /.well-known/atlas-agent.json
OpenAPI schema: /openapi.json
MCP Streamable HTTP: /mcp/{workspaceId}
Portable skill: /agent/atlas-canvas.skill
Readable skill instructions: /agent/atlas-canvas/SKILL.md

Agents require a private connection bundle copied by the workspace owner from Ask an agent → Connect an agent. Never infer, scrape, or request credentials from page source. Never place credentials in canvas content.
